从一纸侨批，读懂山海牵挂: What a letter carried across the sea
近距离观摩侨批档案，在字迹与汇兑印章间，读懂“银信合一”背后的亲情与家国情怀。: We examined handwriting and remittance stamps on original qiaopi to see how money and words sustained families across the sea.
我们的寻侨之旅，从福建省档案馆启程。一封封泛黄的侨批，将百年前海外游子的生活与牵: Our journey began at the Fujian Provincial Archives. In the yellowed letters we found traces of daily life overseas a century ago and of the people the writers worried about at home.
近距离观摩侨批档案原件，辨读批笺上的字迹与汇兑印章，我们逐渐理解“银信合一”的含: Up close, we could make out names, words of advice and signatures alongside the remittance stamps. Each sheet carried money a family could live on and a message from the person who had earned it. Those small details made the writers’ lives abroad feel tangible.
通过与福建省档案馆编研开发处郑宗伟处长交流，队员们进一步了解侨批的收藏与研究，并: Zheng Zongwei, director of the archives’ compilation and research division, spoke with us about collecting and studying qiaopi. We discussed ways to reach new readers. The visit gave us historical leads for our interviews and visits to emigrants’ hometowns.

梧林传统村落及侨批馆: Wulin Traditional Village and Qiaopi Museum
走进古厝，寻找侨乡记忆: Reading the village through its houses
泉州晋江 · 梧林传统村落及侨批馆: Jinjiang, Quanzhou · Wulin Traditional Village and Qiaopi Museum
穿行红砖古厝与番仔楼，走进侨批馆，寻找华侨远渡重洋、心系桑梓的历史印记。: We walked past red-brick homes and mansions built by returning emigrants, then visited a museum that preserves the letters they sent home.
走进梧林，红砖古厝与中西合璧的番仔楼映入眼帘。我们沿着村落的街巷，寻找侨批之外的: In Wulin, red-brick houses stand beside mansions that blend Chinese and Western architecture. We followed the village lanes to see how people expressed their longing for home beyond the pages of a letter.
团队穿行村落、参观侨批馆，将建筑中的华侨印记与展陈中的书信故事相互对照，认识海外: Walking through Wulin and its qiaopi museum, we matched stories in the letters with traces of overseas life in the buildings. The houses brought together the places where their owners had lived and the culture of the village they had left.
从一封家书到一座故居，原本停留在纸上的乡愁有了可感可见的模样。一砖一瓦间的历史，: In a former family home, the longing we had read about on paper took physical form. Bricks and roof tiles gave us a better sense of what coming home meant and supplied details for the designs we would later make.

实践队参观梧林古村落侨批馆，在展陈中寻找华侨与故乡的联系。: At the village museum, we looked for connections between emigrants and the homes they left behind.
侨批代书人访谈: An interview with a qiaopi scribe
听代书人讲述，一封侨批如何写成: How a scribe wrote a letter home
泉州石狮 · 访谈姜明典老先生: Shishi, Quanzhou · A conversation with Jiang Mingdian
聆听姜明典老先生讲述代书往事，从称谓、行文到落款，记录一门替人传情的手艺。: Jiang Mingdian recalled writing letters for others. From the first greeting to the signature, we recorded how he put someone else’s feelings into words.
离开晋江梧林后，我们来到泉州石狮寻访侨批代书人。姜明典老先生的讲述与示范，让纸上: After leaving Wulin, we traveled to Shishi to meet a qiaopi scribe. Jiang Mingdian’s stories and demonstration gave a voice to the history we had found on paper.
从称谓礼仪、行文格式到遣词造句，老先生现场演示代书侨批的过程。队员们围坐聆听、记: We sat around the table as Mr. Jiang showed us how to address a recipient, organize a letter and choose the right words. Knowing the conventions was only part of his craft. He also had to hear the longing or concern in a sender’s voice and express it faithfully.
这次访谈成为后续数字创作的重要起点。老先生的指导与示范为“侨批代书”程序设计提供: His demonstration helped us design our digital letter writer. His account of an emigrant who saved his father also became material for our story game, giving an oral memory another way to travel.

实践队与姜明典老先生在门前合影: The team and Jiang Mingdian standing together outside the doorway
在古城烟火中，感受侨批温度: Finding family voices in Zhangzhou’s old town
在古城中的侨批展陈里，理解书信承载的亲情、诚信与责任，思考传统文化如何走近青年。: Letters on display raised questions about how to share the family bonds, trust and responsibilities they express with younger readers.
沿着侨批的线索，我们来到漳州古城侨批馆。侨批文化与古城生活相融，让历史在街巷间可: Our next stop was the Qiaopi Museum in Zhangzhou Old Town. Here the exhibits are part of a living neighborhood, and the history feels close at hand in the surrounding lanes.
通过参观展陈、了解侨批故事，队员们进一步认识侨批承载的亲情、诚信与责任，也关注到: The exhibitions showed how much sending a letter depended on family ties, trust and a sense of duty. We also considered the museum’s role in bringing new life to the old town.
此次走访让我们思考：如何让观众愿意停下来读一封侨批，又如何让年轻人在参观之后继续: What might persuade a visitor to stop and read a letter? What could a young reader do after leaving the museum? Those questions guided our first interactive designs and helped us turn field notes into experiences people could try for themselves.
触摸历史原件，认识民间守护者: Meeting the people who preserve original letters
云霄县收藏家协会 · 闽南茶道博物馆: Yunxiao County Collectors Association · Southern Fujian Tea Culture Museum
与龚楠主席研读侨批实物，了解民间收藏与保护，并通过实践基地共建延续这份联系。: Association chair Gong Nan shared original qiaopi with us. A new fieldwork partnership will keep us in touch with the collectors who care for them.
在云霄，我们走进县收藏家协会、闽南茶道博物馆，认识那些让侨批记忆得以留存的民间守: In Yunxiao we visited the county collectors association and the Southern Fujian Tea Culture Museum to meet local people who preserve qiaopi.
龚楠主席向团队展示多年珍藏的侨批实物，并分享收藏与研究心得。队员们近距离观察、研: Gong Nan showed us letters he had collected over many years and spoke about studying them. Examining the originals together helped us understand how private family correspondence came to be recognized as world documentary heritage.
一件件被妥善留存的原件，让我们认识到民间力量在侨批保护中的作用。团队与闽南茶道博: The survival of each letter owes something to the people who kept it. Our team signed a fieldwork agreement with the Southern Fujian Tea Culture Museum (Yunxiao Collectors Association) to support future research, archival work, digital projects and volunteering.

返回福州 · 成果创作: Back in Fuzhou · Creating our projects
把沿途故事，写进数字作品: Turning stories from the road into digital works
将走访与访谈所得转化为剧情游戏、AI 代书程序、宣传视频和“侨燕”文创，让侨批故: We turned visits and interviews into a story game, an AI letter writer, a short film and designs featuring Qiaoyan, our swallow mascot.
带着访谈记录与调研素材返回福州，我们整理故事、打磨脚本、设计互动，让沿途遇见的人: Back in Fuzhou, we sorted our interviews and research, revised scripts and designed interactions around the people and places we had encountered.
团队开发侨批剧情游戏《侨批·海那边是家》，以1947年的闽南侨乡与南洋为故事背景: Our story game, Qiaopi: Home Across the Sea, takes place in southern Fujian and Southeast Asia in 1947. Players follow characters drawn from our interviews, making choices and solving puzzles as they learn how qiaopi reached their recipients.
“侨批代书”程序结合传统代书规范，提供用语润色与书写建议，并融入寄送流程体验，让: Our digital scribe draws on traditional letter-writing conventions. It helps people choose words, write their own qiaopi and experience sending it. An online survey and the scribe’s demonstration informed the design.
队员们整理走访影像与访谈片段，制作社会实践宣传视频，以青年视角分享侨乡见闻。同时: We edited field footage and interviews into a short film about the hometowns we visited. For Qiaoyan and its merchandise, we drew on swallowtail roof ridges, red-brick houses, envelopes and postmarks to bring qiaopi imagery into everyday life.

团队在福建省档案馆参观侨批展览，从新加坡华侨寄回同安的家书中了解海外华侨与家乡的: At the archives, students read letters sent from Singapore to Tong’an to learn how emigrants stayed in touch with their hometown.
